name: base_convert
description: Convert numbers between bases 2 to 36, fractions included, with the repeating block found exactly (0.1 is 0.0(0011) in binary); Roman numerals both ways with strict validation (1 to 3999); two's complement of a given bit width both ways; and 8421 binary-coded decimal both ways. Arbitrary-size integers, no floating point.

value.description: Digits in from_base (convert: '-FF.8', '1/7', '0x1F'), an integer, a Roman numeral, or a bit string

from_base.description: Omitted: 10, or read from a 0x / 0o / 0b prefix

fraction_digits.description: Limit on fractional digits before giving up on finding the period

catalog.source: original; positional notation by exact long division (Knuth, TAOCP vol. 2, 4.4), standard subtractive Roman numerals, two's complement and 8421 BCD as in computer-architecture texts
